record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:76 — Case-sensitive comparison of unnormalized email input lets casing variants bypass existing-attendee deduplication and blacklist enforcement

adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 76 in addGuests.handler.ts, the code filters guests with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)` and checks blacklist with `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. The blacklist is lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` emails are not normalized to lowercase before comparison. This means 'USER@example.com' would bypass the blacklist check for 'user@example.com'. Similarly, the attendee deduplication uses direct string comparison without case normalization, so 'User@Example.com' would not match an existing attendee 'user@example.com'. This is a real bug where email case variants can bypass both checks.
